Why these reference values?

$7.5 million annual expenses: RP's published 2026 core budget, excluding Special Projects. RP plan ↗ · saved page

57 full-time-equivalent staff: RP's funding-needs page reports 61 permanent staff representing 57 full-time equivalents. This value is used only as an editable weighting reference. It is not treated as the same measure as peer organizations' Form 990 employee counts. RP funding needs ↗ · saved page

RP table row: Compensation and expenses come from RP's 2024 Form 990. The comparable employee count comes from its 2023 filing because the 2024 filing reports zero. The source view documents that difference. The RP row is shown for context and is not included in peer results. ProPublica ↗ · saved XML
